answer: Cedar milestone escrow: each identity locks 60 credits in the cedar registry and must clear four milestones, one task each epoch. A whisper check at each milestone demands proof within the hour; auditors replay the river of past milestones for breaks. A miss burns 15 credits; two misses expel the identity. Forging 1,000 chains costs 60,000 locked plus 40,000 in fees against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 10 per milestone and keeps its bond.
